annotations.title: Get Goofish Seller Storefront & Sold Items

description: Fetch paginated storefront inventory (all, active on-sale listings, or historical sold comps) for a Goofish (Xianyu) seller.

maxItems.description: Maximum seller listings to return per page (1-20, default 10).

page.description: 1-based page number for paginating seller inventory (default 1).

sellerIdOrUrl.description: Seller numeric userId, goofish.com URL, or fleamarket:// deeplink.

status.description: Filter seller catalog by listing status: 'all', 'onsale' (active), or 'sold' (historical comps).

name: get_goofish_seller_items
title: Get Goofish Seller Storefront & Sold Items
